# Copilot Instructions

The repository's guidance for coding agents lives in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repo root,
and applies to Copilot as much as to any other agent: build and test commands, target
frameworks, code style, comment rules, test conventions and the per-package architecture.
Read it before changing code.

When reviewing a pull request, make only high-confidence suggestions, and judge new code against
the style of the file it lands in.
